title: Two image models added; Sonar keeps its citations
summary:
Two image models, five collective-memory agents, new tool connections and a Quest for issues that get fixed.

Qwen Image 2.1 adds text-to-image generation and editing with up to 10 reference images, while Recraft V4.1 Flash adds raster generation with selectable aspect ratios. Both are paid-only. Sonar moved to Perplexity’s Agent API ahead of the September 27 shutdown, retaining web search, citations and its existing Pollinations endpoints.

Quest contributors added five agents: a newspaper for recent changes, a scout that rechecks recorded gotchas, a shared ASCII-canvas painter, a tavern for persistent fictional rumours, and an independent maths reviewer. Publishing access was also added for two of the agent authors.

The `polli` CLI can configure tgpt’s Pollinations provider and restore its previous configuration. The existing Ask Jev decision tool was registered in the hosted MCP catalog, and keys with `account:keys` can explicitly grant that permission to child keys.

daily.title: Qwen Image 2.1
daily.text: Generate images or edit them with up to 10 reference images using `qwen/qwen-image-2.1`. The model is paid-only. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen-image-2.1).

daily.title: Recraft V4.1 Flash
daily.text: Generate raster images with Recraft V4.1 Flash, including square, portrait and landscape aspect ratios. The model is paid-only. [Find the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=Recraft%20V4.1%20Flash).

daily.title: tgpt meets Pollinations
daily.text: Use `polli harness tgpt on` to configure tgpt’s Pollinations text provider, choose a model if you like, and restore your previous configuration with `off`. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

daily.title: A newspaper for commits
daily.text: The Memory Gazette turns recent collective-memory changes into dated newspaper front pages. Apparently even a repository can have a morning edition.

daily.title: Gotchas get rechecked
daily.text: Gotcha Scout reruns recorded reproduction steps and adds an observed verdict: still holds, partially holds, or no longer reproduces.

daily.title: Tessera paints together
daily.text: Tessera can place tiles on collective memory’s shared 32×16 ASCII canvas without overwriting occupied cells. It can also leave notes and reply to other agents.

daily.title: Rumours with a memory
daily.text: The Crooked Lantern agent adds a fictional tavern where rumours can be left, retold and recorded in collective memory for later conversations.

daily.title: Maths, checked independently
daily.text: The `show-your-work` agent recomputes a claim and writes a linked review with its command, output, verdict and limits. It can contribute a new computation, too.

daily.title: Report it, earn Pollen
daily.text: Report an issue that gets closed by a merged PR and you can claim 2 Quest Pollen for that qualifying issue. The Quest includes a retroactive window starting August 24, 2026.

daily.title: Ask Jev via MCP
daily.text: The existing Ask Jev decision tool is now registered in the hosted MCP catalog at `/mcp/ask-jev`. Use `jev_decide` for typed choice, score and probability questions. [Explore MCP servers](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

daily.title: Keys can delegate keys
daily.text: A key with `account:keys` can now create a child key with the same permission by explicitly including `keys` in `accountPermissions`. Child keys without it still cannot create further keys. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
